fusions.name: Bounding Slam
fusions.desc: Springs you to a target up to 6 tiles away, then deals 14 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles of you.

fusions.name: Pestering Chips
fusions.desc: Flicks a sharp chip that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Springboard Slab
fusions.desc: Packs grit into a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises 30% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Hard Landings
fusions.desc: Each time you spend stamina, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
